# Shared disk-backed temp-dir resolver + stale pytest-root prune helper

Parent: SA-0MW2QED9M005FWOK (disk-backed TMPDIR + stale pytest-root prune)

## Goal

Provide one small, standard-library-only shared helper that both the test
runner (`skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py`) and `implement.py` can import, so
there is a single source of truth for (a) resolving a disk-backed temporary
directory and (b) pruning stale `pytest-of-<user>/pytest-*` roots. This is the
foundation feature: it lands the helper and its unit tests before any wiring.

## Background

`/tmp` is tmpfs with 1,048,576 inodes. Under multi-agent load, stale
`/tmp/pytest-of-<user>/pytest-*` roots (~5-20k files each) exhausted it
(`df -i /tmp` at 100 %) while the byte budget was only ~24 % used. Nothing in
the framework sets `TMPDIR`, so every suite subprocess defaults to the small
tmpfs. See the parent item for the full evidence and the two-option desired
change.

## Targeted outcome

A new module `skill/shared/test_tmpdir.py` exposes:

- `resolve_test_tmpdir()` → `(path, reason)` resolving a candidate in the
  documented precedence order:
  1. explicit environment override (documented constant, e.g.
     `PI_TEST_TMPDIR`);
  2. a configured disk-backed dir such as `/var/tmp/pi-test-<uid>` (created
     when absent);
  3. `tempfile.gettempdir()` as the final safe fallback (macOS/Windows/CI).
- `prune_stale_test_roots()` → `(removed_count, reason)` removing
  `pytest-of-<user>/pytest-*` roots older than a configurable threshold
  (default ~60 min), never touching another user's roots, keeping the
  `pytest-current` symlink target and the N most recent roots, and
  best-effort skipping roots an active pytest process may hold. No-op when
  the base directory is absent.
- Both helpers are **fail-open**: any error is caught, logged/returned as a
  reason string, and never raised. No new dependency — `pathlib`, `shutil`,
  `tempfile`, `os` only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `skill/shared/test_tmpdir.py` exists with `resolve_test_tmpdir()` and
      `prune_stale_test_roots()`, each returning a resolved value plus a
      reason string, using only the Python standard library.
- [ ] TMPDIR resolution follows the documented precedence order and creates a
      missing disk-backed directory; when no disk-backed candidate is usable
      it falls back to `tempfile.gettempdir()`.
- [ ] Prune removes `pytest-of-<user>/pytest-*` roots older than the
      threshold, keeps the `pytest-current` target and the newest N roots, is
      scoped to the current user, and is a no-op when the base directory is
      absent.
- [ ] Both helpers are fail-open: a forced error returns a reason string and
      never raises.
- [ ] `skill/shared/tests/test_test_tmpdir.py` covers precedence, the
      no-disk-backed fallback (mocked `tempfile.gettempdir()`), the prune
      safety rules against a temporary fixture directory (stale removed,
      current/newest kept), the base-absent no-op, foreign-user safety, and
      both forced-failure paths.
- [ ] Module docstrings document the precedence order, prune rules, and
      fail-open contract.

## Minimal implementation

- Add `skill/shared/test_tmpdir.py` with the two helpers, a configurable env
  override constant, a configurable age threshold and keep-N constants.
- Implement prune with `Path.iterdir()` + `stat().st_mtime`, resolving the
  `pytest-current` symlink target first and keeping the newest-N roots.
- Keep the user scope to `getpass.getuser()` / `os.getuid()`-equivalent.
- Add the unit tests under `skill/shared/tests/`.
- Do NOT wire into run_tests.py or implement.py here — that is the next
  feature's scope.

## Key files

- `skill/shared/test_tmpdir.py` (new)
- `skill/shared/tests/test_test_tmpdir.py` (new)

## Dependencies

- None (foundation feature).

## Risky assumptions

- `/var/tmp` exists and is disk-backed on the affected Linux host; macOS/CI
  fall back to `tempfile.gettempdir()`.
- The `pytest-current` symlink is created by pytest's `--basetemp`/tmpdir
  machinery; resolve it defensively when absent.
data.title: Shared disk-backed temp-dir resolver + stale pytest-root prune helper

# Wire disk-backed TMPDIR + stale-root prune into the test runner

Parent: SA-0MW2QED9M005FWOK (disk-backed TMPDIR + stale pytest-root prune)
Depends on: F1 (shared `skill/shared/test_tmpdir.py` helper)

## Goal

Make the test runner (`skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py`) pass a disk-backed
`TMPDIR` to every suite command it spawns and prune stale pytest roots before
a full-suite run, without changing any suite command string, cache key or
scope resolution.

## Existing state (verified)

- Every suite command is spawned by `_run_cmd()` with
  `env=_suite_command_env()`; `_suite_command_env()` layers
  `test_runner.subprocess_env_with_scrubbed_overrides()` and
  `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS`. That helper is the single insertion point for
  `TMPDIR` — the scrub touches only repository overrides, so `TMPDIR` passes
  through untouched today and is simply never set.
- The full-scope path resolves commands inside `run_all(...)` (the
  `if commands is None` branch, `resolvable_scope = "full"`); the prune hook
  belongs there (or in `guarded_run_all` before `run_all`), so it runs at
  least for full scope.

## Targeted outcome

- `_suite_command_env()` sets `TMPDIR` from
  `shared.test_tmpdir.resolve_test_tmpdir()` (the helper from F1), logging at
  INFO when a disk-backed dir is chosen and at DEBUG/WARNING when a candidate
  is unusable.
- The full-scope entry path calls
  `shared.test_tmpdir.prune_stale_test_roots()` before executing, logging the
  removed count + freed paths at INFO.
- Both calls are fail-open: any helper error is logged and the run proceeds
  unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `_suite_command_env()` sets a disk-backed `TMPDIR` on the child env for
      every suite command; a unit test asserts the env handed to the spawned
      command carries the resolved TMPDIR, and covers the fallback path when
      no disk-backed candidate exists.
- [ ] The full-scope path invokes the stale-root prune before execution; a
      unit test asserts the prune is invoked for full scope (and that a
      changed-scope run does not regress command selection).
- [ ] Fail-open is proven by a test that forces the TMPDIR resolver and the
      prune helper to raise and asserts the run's exit status, cache entry and
      scope resolution are unchanged (log only).
- [ ] Suite command strings, cache keys and changed/full scope resolution are
      byte-identical (env-only change); a regression test pins the command
      string / cache key.
- [ ] Logging uses INFO for a chosen disk-backed TMPDIR and for pruned roots,
      DEBUG/WARNING for an unusable candidate.

- [ ] No behaviour change to test selection or caching: changed/full scope
      resolution, cache keys and the audit-accepted full-suite cache entry
      are unchanged (the TMPDIR/prune work is env-only and does not alter
      any suite command string).

## Minimal implementation

- Import the F1 helpers in `run_tests.py`.
- In `_suite_command_env()`: resolve TMPDIR once (module-level cache is
  acceptable) and set `env["TMPDIR"]`.
- In `guarded_run_all()` (before `run_all`) or the full-scope branch of
  `run_all`: call the prune when the resolved scope is full.
- Add `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_tmpdir.py` and
  `skill/test/tests/test_prune_stale_test_roots.py`.
- Never rewrite a command string; never alter cache key derivation.

## Key files

- `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` — `_suite_command_env` + full-scope prune hook + logging
- `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_tmpdir.py` (new)
- `skill/test/tests/test_prune_stale_test_roots.py` (new)

## Dependencies

- F1 (helper module + unit tests).

## Risky assumptions

- `_suite_command_env()` is the only child-env construction path for suite
  commands (verified: `_run_cmd()` is the single spawn point).
- Pruning before a changed-scope run is unnecessary; full scope is the
  churn-heavy path the bug reported.
data.title: Wire disk-backed TMPDIR + stale-root prune into the test runner

# implement.py parity — export disk-backed TMPDIR to build/test/push children

Parent: SA-0MW2QED9M005FWOK (disk-backed TMPDIR + stale pytest-root prune)
Depends on: F1 (shared `skill/shared/test_tmpdir.py` helper)

## Goal

Close the observed failure end-to-end: the finish gate's `git push` child and
the build/test subprocesses must inherit the same disk-backed `TMPDIR` that
the test runner uses, so the pre-push full-suite hook never runs on the
inode-starved tmpfs.

## Existing state (verified)

- `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py` imports the test-skill helpers and
  runs the suite in-process via `run_tests.guarded_run_all`, so runner-side
  env changes are inherited there.
- The push path is different: `git_push_to_dev()` spawns
  `["git", "push", ...]` with `env={**os.environ}`. The pre-push hook then
  runs `run_tests.py` as a child of `git push`, so it only sees a `TMPDIR`
  that `implement.py` has exported into its own environment (or the push
  child env).

## Targeted outcome

- `implement.py` resolves the disk-backed TMPDIR via the F1 helper and
  exports it into the environment of:
  1. the build subprocess,
  2. the in-process/full-suite test step (child subprocesses it spawns), and
  3. the finish-gate `git push` child (`env={**os.environ}` augmented with the
     resolved `TMPDIR`).
- The export is scoped to spawned child environments: it must not leak into
  the parent interactive shell after the run.
- Fail-open: a resolution error is logged and the push/build proceeds with the
  ambient environment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `git_push_to_dev()` adds the resolved disk-backed `TMPDIR` to the
      `git push` child environment, so the pre-push hook's `run_tests.py`
      inherits it.
- [ ] The build subprocess and the test-suite step inherit the same resolved
      `TMPDIR`.
- [ ] The export is scoped to child environments and does not mutate the
      operator's parent shell environment.
- [ ] Fail-open: a helper error is logged and the push/build proceeds
      unchanged (exit status unchanged).
- [ ] A test asserts the push child env carries the resolved `TMPDIR` and that
      the build/test env carries it; a forced-failure test proves fail-open.

- [ ] implement.py parity: the finish build/test/push subprocesses (and
      therefore the pre-push full-suite gate) inherit the same disk-backed
      `TMPDIR`, so the observed failure mode is closed end-to-end.

## Minimal implementation

- Import `resolve_test_tmpdir` from the F1 helper (with the same
  import-fallback pattern already used for the test-skill helpers).
- Resolve once per `finish` invocation; inject `TMPDIR` into the child envs
  (build Popen, push Popen). Prefer passing it explicitly to the subprocess
  call rather than leaking into `os.environ`; if a global export is needed for
  the in-process `guarded_run_all`, save/restore around the call.
- Add `skill/implement/tests/test_implement_tmpdir.py`.

## Key files

- `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py` — build/test/push child env
- `skill/implement/tests/test_implement_tmpdir.py` (new)

## Dependencies

- F1 (helper module).

## Risky assumptions

- The pre-push hook creates no temp dirs of its own and relies on inheritance
  (verified: `.githooks/pre-push` / `pre-push.v2` only invoke
  `run_tests.py --scope full --strict-git-env`).
- The finish gate's temporary-index / isolated-`TMPDIR` behaviour
  (`docs/dev/implement-skill-reference.md`) stays compatible: the disk-backed
  TMPDIR replaces only the ambient default, not any explicit gate override.
data.title: implement.py parity — export disk-backed TMPDIR to build/test/push children
